title: Bolt's Boogie
logline: A shy robot overcomes its social anxiety to find joy on the dance floor at a vibrant rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, embracing joy, finding belonging.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, shy robot with optical sensors that betray its longing to join in.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A friendly and outgoing human party-goer who encourages Bolt.

characters.name: DJ Beats
characters.one_line_description: The unseen but influential DJ whose music sets the mood for the party.

scenes.title: The Awkward Arrival
scenes.summary: Bolt, a small, shy robot, arrives at a bustling rooftop party, looking overwhelmed by the loud music and dancing crowd.
scenes.setting: Vibrant rooftop party, city skyline at dusk.

scenes.title: Observing the Moves
scenes.summary: Bolt stands near the edge, its optical sensors tracking the energetic dancers, a subtle longing in its posture. The music is infectious.
scenes.setting: Dance floor at a rooftop party.

scenes.title: A Friendly Invitation
scenes.summary: Maya, a lively human party-goer, notices Bolt's hesitation. She smiles warmly and gestures for Bolt to join the dance floor.
scenes.setting: Edge of the dance floor, rooftop party.

scenes.title: The First Wobble
scenes.summary: With Maya's encouragement, Bolt takes a few wobbly steps onto the dance floor, attempting some stiff, jerky movements. Maya claps playfully.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: As the music changes, Bolt's movements become a little smoother, finding a basic rhythm. A small light on its chest flickers green, indicating growing confidence.
scenes.setting: Dance floor, surrounded by other dancers.

scenes.title: Bolt's Dance Party
scenes.summary: Bolt is now fully engaged, performing unique, fluid robot dance moves, much to the delight of Maya and other cheering party-goers. It's having the time of its life.
scenes.setting: Center of the dance floor, high energy.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
